title: Sending and Missions
definition: Sending and Missions is the Church's participation in Christ's commission by sending workers, supporting Gospel labor, and proclaiming Christ among all peoples.
summary: Sending and Missions focuses on the Church's responsibility to pray for, support, and send Gospel workers.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His witnesses to the nations with the message of repentance and forgiveness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sending and missions is the church's participation in taking the Gospel beyond itself. Scripture shows churches praying, sending, supporting, and partnering so Christ is proclaimed among peoples and places that need Him.

Missions is not spiritual tourism or ministry branding. It is Gospel obedience that may require sacrifice, patience, cultural humility, and long-term faithfulness.

Jesus is the sent Son and the sending Lord. His authority and compassion move the church outward with the message of repentance and forgiveness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can celebrate mission while remaining comfortable and self-focused. Sending and missions reminds believers that the Gospel is for neighbors and nations, not only for those already gathered.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for workers, give sacrificially, support faithful missionaries, and be willing to go or send as Christ leads. Keep missions centered on the Gospel, discipleship, and love rather than adventure or recognition.
